name: Shared World
description: One world for several Game mode adventures. Create a shared game, add its players, and link each Game mode chat to it: every deed a Game Master reply records (a hold taken, a faction angered, a fact learned) is shared once you answer that reply, and every other linked chat sees it as news and as part of its world, with who did it. A shared calendar keeps every party's day at or past the real days since the game began. Needs the custom-mods Marinara Engine with the shared-world seam. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Shared World.
